preconditions.description: The number of bracket types is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(-n <= a_i <= n and a_i != 0 for a_i, _ in cards)
preconditions.description: Each front number is within the valid range and non-zero.

preconditions.expression: all(-n <= b_i <= n and b_i != 0 for _, b_i in cards)
preconditions.description: Each back number is within the valid range and non-zero.

preconditions.expression: set(a_i for a_i, _) == set(b_i for _, b_i) == set(range(-n, 0)) | set(range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each integer 1, -1, 2, -2, ..., n, -n appears exactly once on the front and exactly once on the back.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' if is_balanced(front_sequence) and is_balanced(back_sequence) else return_value[0] == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is returned, both the front and back sequences are balanced. If 'NO' is returned, neither sequence is balanced.
If 'YES' is returned, the sequences are balanced.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == 2 * n + 1 if return_value[0] == 'YES' else len(return_value) == 1
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is returned, there are 2n+1 lines in the output. If 'NO' is returned, there is exactly one line.
